2607.00057.title: Enhancing Oracle Bone Inscription Recognition via Multi-Scale Layer Attention
2607.00057.paper_summary: Oracle Bone Inscriptions (OBIs) recognition plays a crucial role in understanding ancient Chinese culture. However, accurately recognizing OBIs remains highly challenging due to their complex, irregular, and often degraded shapes. Traditional methods rely on expert knowledge and manual analysis, which are time-consuming and error-prone. Although deep learning has greatly advanced general image recognition, existing methods struggle to capture the fine-grained details and subtle variations inherent in OBIs, resulting in limited performance. Even most recent and effective layer attention techniques are designed to capture fine-grained dependencies through enhanced inter-layer interactions, yet they still exhibit only marginal improvements in OBIs recognition. To address these limitations, we propose Multi-Scale Layer Attention (MSLA), a novel paradigm that explicitly models both multi-scale and cross-layer feature interactions. By enriching the representation with fine-grained details across multiple spatial scales, MSLA enables more accurate and robust OBIs recognition. Extensive experiments on large-scale OBIs datasets demonstrate that MSLA consistently outperforms existing attention mechanisms while maintaining computational efficiency.
2607.00057.paper_summary_zh: 甲骨文識別在理解古代中國文化中扮演著至關重要的角色。<lb/>然而，由於其形狀複雜、不規則且經常退化，準確識別甲骨文仍然非常具有挑戰性。<lb/>傳統方法依賴專家知識和手動分析，這些方法耗時且容易出錯。<lb/>儘管深度學習在一般圖像識別方面取得了重大進展，但現有方法仍難以捕捉甲骨文中固有的細微細節和微妙變化，導致性能有限。<lb/>即使是最近最有效的層注意力技術也旨在通過增強層間交互來捕捉細粒度的依賴性，但在甲骨文識別中仍僅顯示出邊際改善。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了多尺度層注意力（MSLA），這是一種明確建模多尺度和跨層特徵交互的新範式。<lb/>通過在多個空間尺度上豐富細粒度細節的表示，MSLA 使甲骨文識別更加準確和穩健。<lb/>在大規模甲骨文數據集上的廣泛實驗表明，MSLA 始終優於現有的注意力機制，同時保持計算效率。
